4160.title: Pruning loses storage cleanup ownership
4160.rootCauseOneLine: Environment pruning clears the thread environment reference; deletion treats null as completed storage cleanup and hard-deletes the thread without a host request.
4160.proposedFix: Preserve host storage ownership beyond environment pruning and retain deletion tombstones until host acknowledgement.
4160.caveats: Route-level reproduction with real SQLite and captured host RPC; no live daemon or reporter storage-scale audit. No PR: stored-data/ownership or retention design exceeds simple-fix limits. Complete test and decisive output embedded in HTML; standalone artifacts retained locally per reports repository policy.
